content.text: {"class": "TEST_DATA", "reasoning": "The test consumed a pre-existing shared record (SUB-70001, owned by QA-SHARED-04 and used by 11 tests) that nightly suite #2117 moved from ACTIVE to CANCELLED between the last green build and this run, so the record the test did not create was left in a terminal state. Under the stale test account state tie-break, a wrong value in a row of the product's own data model is TEST_DATA, regardless of whether an earlier CI run caused the staleness. The product behaved correctly for the state it was given, returning 409 SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_RENEWABLE, so PRODUCT_DEFECT is excluded, and the test's ID literal is a reference to a record that was supposed to be renewable, not a wrong expectation."}
